rows.section: Personal income tax (данък върху доходите на физическите лица, art. 48)
rows.basis: Annual tax base (monthly tax base for salaries): gross income less the employee's social and health insurance and the reliefs
rows.note: A flat 10% applies to the total annual tax base (art. 17). On salaries the employer withholds 10% of the monthly tax base each month. Sole traders (see the items under review) and the final taxes on investment income have their own rates.

rows.section: Income tax (porez na dohodak) 2026: default rates
rows.label: Lower rate: tax base up to the threshold
rows.basis: Annual tax base (income less contributions and the personal allowance), residents
rows.note: Every city and municipality sets its own lower and higher rate within statutory limits; these 20% and 30% rates apply where it has made no decision (489 of 556 units in 2026). rows.section: Personal income tax (φόρος εισοδήματος) from tax year 2026
rows.basis: Annual taxable income (calendar tax year), after exemptions and deductions
rows.note: The 2026 tax reform (Law 244(I)/2025) raised the tax-free amount from €19,500 to €22,000 and widened the bands; the top rate of 35% now starts above €72,000. Employers withhold the tax monthly (PAYE) using the deductions the employee declares on form T.D.59. Self-employed profits are taxed on the same scale.
rows.source_title: Tax Department: Declaration for claiming tax deductions for the tax year 2026 (Form T.D.59A, English), Part C Tax computation

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound or expat tax regime
rows.value: None: residents (home in Czechia or 183 days in the year) are taxed on worldwide income at the normal rates; the Income Tax Act has no relief for new residents
rows.note: Self-employed contribution figures are the 2026 amounts published by ČSSZ and VZP; paušální daň amounts are those published by the Financial Administration.
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2026, § 2

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital Nomad programme (Program digitální nomád)
rows.value: IT and marketing specialists from Australia, Brazil, India, Israel, Japan, Canada, South Korea, Mexico, New Zealand, Singapore, United Kingdom, United States, Taiwan: employees of a foreign employer with at least 50 staff, or freelancers with a Czech trade licence; long-term visa decided within 45 days
rows.note: Self-employed contribution figures are the 2026 amounts published by ČSSZ and VZP; paušální daň amounts are those published by the Financial Administration.
rows.source_title: Ministerstvo průmyslu a obchodu: Program digitální nomád (version of 1 July 2025)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital Nomad programme: income requirement
rows.value: At least 1.5× the average gross annual wage announced by the Ministry of Labour
rows.note: Self-employed contribution figures are the 2026 amounts published by ČSSZ and VZP; paušální daň amounts are those published by the Financial Administration.
rows.source_title: Ministerstvo průmyslu a obchodu: Program digitální nomád (version of 1 July 2025)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital Nomad programme: tax consequence
rows.value: No special regime: a nomad who becomes tax resident (183 days or a home in Czechia) pays Czech income tax; freelancers also pay Czech social and health insurance
rows.note: Self-employed contribution figures are the 2026 amounts published by ČSSZ and VZP; paušální daň amounts are those published by the Financial Administration.
rows.source_title: e-Sbírka: Zákon č. 586/1992 Sb., o daních z příjmů, consolidated version in force from 1 August 2026, § 2

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Long-term visa for business (vízum k pobytu nad 90 dnů za účelem podnikání)
rows.value: Trade licence or company registration, accommodation and funds of 50× the existence minimum (CZK 156,500); valid up to 1 year, then a long-term residence permit for business
rows.note: Self-employed contribution figures are the 2026 amounts published by ČSSZ and VZP; paušální daň amounts are those published by the Financial Administration.
rows.source_title: Ministerstvo vnitra: Prostředky k pobytu pro účely dlouhodobého víza

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Where to apply
rows.value: Visa: a Czech embassy or consulate abroad (decided by the Ministry of the Interior); residence permit renewals: the Ministry of the Interior (OAMP); Digital Nomad inclusion: the Ministry of Industry and Trade; trade licence: a trade licensing office (živnostenský úřad)
rows.note: Self-employed contribution figures are the 2026 amounts published by ČSSZ and VZP; paušální daň amounts are those published by the Financial Administration.
rows.source_title: Ministerstvo vnitra: Prostředky k pobytu pro účely dlouhodobého víza

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Income tax for the self-employed
rows.value: Business profit is taxed with the same state, municipal and church taxes as salary; income tax and AM-bidrag are paid as B-tax in ten monthly instalments
rows.note: AM-bidrag is charged on business profit as on salary. Under the business tax scheme the provisional 22% is credited when the profit is later taken out and taxed as personal income.
rows.source_title: Skattestyrelsen (skat.dk): Am-bidrag (arbejdsmarkedsbidrag)

rows.label: Aalborg (municipality 851)
rows.note: Where kommuneskat + bundskat + mellemskat would exceed the 44.57% tax ceiling, the mellemskat rate is reduced by the difference (0% = no reduction). 11 of the 11 municipalities have a reduction in 2026.

rows.note: One flat rate on the income of resident individuals. The basic exemption (€700 a month, €8,400 a year) is deducted first; from 2026 it no longer falls as income rises. Employers withhold 22% from pay. The planned 2% security tax was not introduced.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound or expat tax regime
rows.value: None: residents are taxed on worldwide income at 22% with the normal basic exemption; there is no reduced rate or exemption for new residents
rows.note: Self-employed figures are the 2026 amounts published by the Tax and Customs Board (EMTA); the visa rules are in the Aliens Act § 62^5 and Interior Minister regulation no. 82.
rows.source_title: Maksu- ja Tolliamet: Residentsuse määramine (last updated 23.10.2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Tax residency
rows.value: A permanent home in Estonia or at least 183 days in Estonia within 12 consecutive months
rows.note: Self-employed figures are the 2026 amounts published by the Tax and Customs Board (EMTA); the visa rules are in the Aliens Act § 62^5 and Interior Minister regulation no. 82.
rows.source_title: Maksu- ja Tolliamet: Residentsuse määramine (last updated 23.10.2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad visa (viisa kaugtöö tegemiseks)
rows.value: A short-stay (C) or long-stay (D) visa for remote work for a foreign employer, the applicant's own foreign company or mainly foreign clients; a D visa allows up to 365 days within 12 months
rows.note: Self-employed figures are the 2026 amounts published by the Tax and Customs Board (EMTA); the visa rules are in the Aliens Act § 62^5 and Interior Minister regulation no. 82.
rows.source_title: Riigi Teataja: Siseministri määrus nr 82 'Pikaajalise viisa andmise, viibimisaja vormistamise ja viibimisaja pikendamise kord ja tähtajad ning piisavate rahaliste vahendite määr' (version in force from 22.05.2026), § 15 lg 7; Välismaalaste seadus § 62^5; 2026. aasta riigieelarve seadus § 2 lg 5 p 5; Politsei- ja Piirivalveamet: Long-term visa

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad visa: sufficient funds per day in Estonia (0.6 × the €220 monthly subsistence level)
rows.note: from 1 January 2026; legal income for the six months before applying must also be documented

rows.label: Where to apply
rows.value: An Estonian representation abroad that handles visas, or a Police and Border Guard Board (PPA) service office in Estonia

rows.value: A government digital ID for running an Estonian company online; it is not tax residency, citizenship, a residence permit, a visa or a right to enter Estonia
rows.note: Self-employed figures are the 2026 amounts published by the Tax and Customs Board (EMTA); the visa rules are in the Aliens Act § 62^5 and Interior Minister regulation no. 82.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Startup permit (residence permit for start-up entrepreneurs)
rows.value: Business Finland assesses the team and business model and gives an eligibility statement (at most 4 months old when applying); the Finnish Immigration Service (Migri) grants the permit for at most 2 years, renewable. A team of at least 2 founders holding at least 60% of the company
rows.note: Permit rules shown are for applicants from outside the EU/EEA. Migri's pages refused automated requests, so its fees and income amounts are not shown.
rows.source_title: Business Finland: Startup Permit – Applying (startupinfinland.com)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Residence permit for self-employed people (entrepreneurs)
rows.value: Granted by Migri after a positive partial decision of the regional Elinvoimakeskus, which checks that the business income secures the applicant's living for the permit period (at the start also wages, start-up funding or own funds)
rows.note: Permit rules shown are for applicants from outside the EU/EEA. Migri's pages refused automated requests, so its fees and income amounts are not shown.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents

rows.section: Withholding tax (staðgreiðsla): three steps, per month
rows.label: Step 1 (skattþrep 1): 16.55% income tax + 14.94% average municipal tax
rows.basis: Monthly pay after the employee's pension contributions, per month
rows.note: Each step's rate applies to the part of the month's pay inside the step. The combined rate is the state income tax (tekjuskattur) plus the average municipal tax (útsvar) of 14.94%, which is used in withholding everywhere; the municipality's own rate is settled in the annual assessment. The personal tax credit is deducted from the tax calculated.

rows.section: Self-employed: calculated remuneration (reiknað endurgjald), 2026 minimums
rows.label: Rule
rows.value: People working in their own business must pay themselves a calculated wage, at least what they would earn doing the same work for an unrelated employer and not below the tax authority's minimum for their category; it is taxed like wages, with withholding tax, tryggingagjald and pension contributions
rows.basis: Minimum monthly calculated remuneration by category
rows.note: A selection of the categories A to H in the tax authority's 2026 rules; the annual amount is 12 × the monthly one (for example ISK 5,664,000 a year in category E(9)).

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: income tax
rows.value: Calculated remuneration is taxed like wages: withholding tax through the three steps with the personal credit, tryggingagjald and pension contributions
rows.note: Iceland has no flat-rate scheme for freelancers. The foreign-expert rule (since 2017) exempts 25% of an approved expert's wages for 3 years; tryggingagjald and benefits are based on the full wages.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital nomad visa: where to apply

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Elective residence visa (DM 850/2011)
rows.value: For people who can support themselves without working in Italy: income of at least 3 times the Interior Ministry's Tabella A amount from pensions, annuities, property or businesses (not employment); applied for at the Italian embassy or consulate
rows.note: The self-employed outside the forfettario pay IRPEF on the national scale plus the surcharges. Contributions: INPS Gestione Separata for professionals without their own fund, or the artigiani and commercianti funds (below).

rows.section: Maximum contribution base and solidarity tax
rows.label: How it works
rows.value: During the year the normal contribution rate (34.09% for an employee) is paid on all pay above the base; after the year the tax is recalculated at 25% and the difference is refunded by 1 September of the following year
rows.basis: Annual contribution object (gross pay; the self-employed: declared income)

rows.section: Maximum contribution base and solidarity tax
rows.label: Interaction with income tax

rows.label: Micro-enterprise tax (mikrouzņēmumu nodoklis)
rows.value: 25% of turnover, replacing income tax and the owner's social insurance; turnover up to the VAT registration threshold (€50,000); in force in 2026
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.

rows.value: €17 a year or €9 a half-year, final tax; only for old-age pensioners or persons with a group 1 or 2 disability in listed crafts and household services, revenue up to €3,000, no employees
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.
rows.source_title: Likumi.lv: likums "Par iedzīvotāju ienākuma nodokli" (consolidated text), 11.10 pants

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: VAT registration threshold: annual domestic supplies (registration may be postponed to year-end if exceeded by up to €5,000)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Remote-work (digital-nomad) visa
rows.value: Yes: long-stay visa for up to 12 months, with one further visa of up to 12 months, for non-EU nationals employed by an employer in an OECD country or self-employed there; no right to work for Latvian employers
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.
rows.source_title: PMLP: Ilgtermiņa vīzas saņemšana attālinātā darba veikšanai (atjaunināts 16.06.2026); Imigrācijas likums 11. panta 5. daļa (likumi.lv)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Remote-work visa: income requirement
rows.value: At least 2.5× the previous year's average monthly gross wage (€4,538 a month per PMLP), plus at least six months with the employer or six months of self-employed income
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.
rows.source_title: PMLP: Ilgtermiņa vīzas saņemšana attālinātā darba veikšanai (atjaunināts 16.06.2026); Imigrācijas likums 11. panta 5. daļa (likumi.lv)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Remote-work visa: optional income tax rate on the remote-work income, for 365 days from becoming resident
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.
rows.source_title: Likumi.lv: likums "Par iedzīvotāju ienākuma nodokli" (consolidated text), 15. panta 19.2 daļa and pārejas noteikumu 195. punkts

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound or expat tax regime
rows.value: No general regime for new residents: residents are taxed on the normal scale with the same non-taxable minimum and reliefs; the only arrival-related rate is the 15% option for remote-work visa holders
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.
rows.source_title: Likumi.lv: likums "Par iedzīvotāju ienākuma nodokli" (consolidated text), 15. pants

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents

rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.

rows.basis: Self-chosen contribution object of at least the minimum wage; reported and paid quarterly (by the 17th and 23rd of the month after the quarter)
rows.note: No unemployment or work-accident cover for the self-employed. From 1 January 2026 the self-employed no longer make minimum contributions. Income above the maximum base is subject to the solidarity tax.
rows.source_title: VID: Pašnodarbinātā sociālās apdrošināšanas iemaksas (atjaunināts 08.10.2026); MK noteikumi Nr. 786, 9.-11. punkts; likums "Par valsts sociālo apdrošināšanu" 14.1 pants

rows.section: Micro-enterprise tax 2026 (mikrouzņēmumu nodoklis)
rows.label: Tax rate on turnover
rows.basis: Quarterly turnover; quarterly return by the 15th of the month after the quarter (only for quarters with turnover)
rows.note: Social insurance for the owner is based on 80% of the tax paid, so benefits and pensions are much lower than under the 31.07% self-employed rate.
rows.source_title: Likumi.lv: Mikrouzņēmumu nodokļa likums (consolidated text), 4., 5., 6. un 8. pants; VID: Mikrouzņēmumu nodoklis (atjaunināts 13.05.2026)

rows.section: Municipal surcharge (Gemeindezuschlag) by municipality
rows.label: Statutory minimum surcharge (share of the national tax)
rows.basis: Share of the national income and wealth tax (1.5 = 150%)
rows.note: Each of the 11 municipal councils fixes its surcharge yearly with the budget. rows.basis: Gain on the sale of Liechtenstein land
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 35 to 43 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Property: real-estate gains tax, property tax and transfer charges
rows.label: Taxable gain
rows.value: Sale price less acquisition cost (the official tax valuation, raised by any higher purchase price and value-adding investments); earlier losses on the property are deductible
rows.basis: Gain on the sale of Liechtenstein land
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 35 to 43 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Property: real-estate gains tax, property tax and transfer charges
rows.label: Annual property tax
rows.value: No separate property tax: real estate is part of taxable wealth (valued at income value, at least the tax valuation) and taxed through the 4% notional yield
rows.basis: Gain on the sale of Liechtenstein land
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 1, 9 and 12 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Property: real-estate gains tax, property tax and transfer charges
rows.label: Property transfer tax and land-register fee
rows.value: No transfer tax; land-register fee 6‰ of the price (minimum CHF 200); mortgage registration 2‰
rows.basis: Gain on the sale of Liechtenstein land
rows.source_title: Grundbuch- und Handelsregistergebührenverordnung (version of 01.08.2024)

rows.section: Property: real-estate gains tax, property tax and transfer charges
rows.label: Land-register fee on the transfer of ownership, share of the price
rows.basis: Gain on the sale of Liechtenstein land
rows.source_title: Grundbuch- und Handelsregistergebührenverordnung (version of 01.08.2024)

rows.section: Property: real-estate gains tax, property tax and transfer charges
rows.label: Land-register fee on the transfer of ownership: minimum per transfer
rows.basis: Gain on the sale of Liechtenstein land
rows.source_title: Grundbuch- und Handelsregistergebührenverordnung (version of 01.08.2024)

rows.section: Property: real-estate gains tax, property tax and transfer charges
rows.label: Land-register fee on registering or increasing a mortgage, share of the amount
rows.basis: Gain on the sale of Liechtenstein land
rows.source_title: Grundbuch- und Handelsregistergebührenverordnung (version of 01.08.2024)

rows.section: Capital income and investment withholding tax
rows.label: Dividends, interest and royalties: withholding tax
rows.value: None: coupon tax abolished from 2011 (only pre-2011 reserves); dividends exempt from income tax
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 24, 157 and 158 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Capital income and investment withholding tax
rows.label: Dividends received by individuals
rows.value: Exempt from income tax
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 15, 24 and 158 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Capital income and investment withholding tax
rows.label: Interest and other investment income
rows.value: Not taxed as income where the capital bears wealth tax (the 4% notional yield is taxed instead)
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 15, 24 and 158 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Capital income and investment withholding tax
rows.label: Capital gains on private assets
rows.value: Exempt from income tax; gains on Liechtenstein land are taxed by the real-estate gains tax
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 15 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Inheritance and gift tax
rows.label: Inheritance, estate and gift tax
rows.value: None since 2011: inheritances and gifts are not taxed as income or by a separate tax; the assets add to the recipient's taxable wealth
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 1, 15 and 157 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Customs territory
rows.value: Liechtenstein is part of the Swiss customs territory (customs treaty of 1923): Swiss customs law, tariff, excise duties and import VAT rules apply, administered by the Swiss Federal Office for Customs and Border Security (BAZG); there are no customs controls with Switzerland
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: Zollvertrag Schweiz–Liechtenstein of 29 March 1923 Art. 1; Kundmachung LGBl. 2026 Nr. 312

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: How duty is charged
rows.value: Specific duties, usually per kg gross weight (including packaging), not a percentage of the value; often under CHF 1 per kg, higher for alcohol, tobacco and food
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: BAZG: Empfangen von Briefen und Paketen; BAZG: Verzollungskosten und Paketverfolgung; BAZG: Zölle

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Duty de minimis: duty amounts not collected up to
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: BAZG: Empfangen von Briefen und Paketen; BAZG: Verzollungskosten und Paketverfolgung; BAZG: Zölle

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Import VAT: standard rate
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: BAZG: Info Zoll für Privatpersonen (01/2025); BAZG: Wertfreigrenze 150 Franken

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Import VAT: reduced rate (food, books, newspapers, medicines)
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: BAZG: Info Zoll für Privatpersonen (01/2025); BAZG: Wertfreigrenze 150 Franken

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Import VAT collection scheme: foreign mail-order sellers register for VAT from annual small-consignment sales of
rows.note: they then charge Liechtenstein/Swiss VAT on every sale; no IOSS-type scheme (MWSTG Art. 7 Abs. 3)
rows.source_title: Mehrwertsteuergesetz (MWSTG) Art. 7 Abs. 3 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Import VAT de minimis: tax amounts not collected up to
rows.note: equal to a goods value of CHF 62 at 8.1% or CHF 193 at 2.6%
rows.source_title: BAZG: Empfangen von Briefen und Paketen; BAZG: Verzollungskosten und Paketverfolgung; BAZG: Zölle

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Import VAT base
rows.value: Price paid plus all costs to the destination (packaging, freight, insurance, clearance charges) and the import duties; foreign VAT shown on the invoice is excluded
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: BAZG: Empfangen von Briefen und Paketen; BAZG: Verzollungskosten und Paketverfolgung; BAZG: Zölle

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Gift parcels between private persons: duty- and VAT-free up to (not alcohol or tobacco)
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: BAZG: Empfangen von Briefen und Paketen; BAZG: Verzollungskosten und Paketverfolgung; BAZG: Zölle

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Clearance fees
rows.value: Charged by the carrier (Swiss Post, DHL, UPS and others) for its work, at its own rates; not set by law
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: BAZG: Empfangen von Briefen und Paketen; BAZG: Verzollungskosten und Paketverfolgung; BAZG: Zölle

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Travellers: VAT-free value of goods, per person and day
rows.note: above it VAT is due on the whole value; single items over CHF 150 always bear VAT
rows.source_title: BAZG: Info Zoll für Privatpersonen (01/2025); BAZG: Wertfreigrenze 150 Franken

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Travellers: alcoholic drinks up to 18% vol, litres duty-free per person and day (age 17 or over)
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: BAZG: Info Zoll für Privatpersonen (01/2025); BAZG: Wertfreigrenze 150 Franken

rows.label: Travellers: alcoholic drinks over 18% vol, litres duty-free per person and day (age 17 or over)

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Travellers: cigarettes, cigars or heated tobacco duty-free, pieces (or 250 g other tobacco; age 17 or over)

rows.source_title: BAZG: Info Zoll für Privatpersonen (01/2025); BAZG: Wertfreigrenze 150 Franken

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Travellers: food allowances per person and day
rows.value: 1 kg meat and meat products; 1 kg or litre butter and cream; 5 kg or litres edible oils and fats

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Duty on quantities above the allowances
rows.value: Spirits over 18% vol CHF 15 per litre; drinks up to 18% vol CHF 2 per litre; cigarettes CHF 0.25 each; meat CHF 17 per kg (up to 10 kg)
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: BAZG: Info Zoll für Privatpersonen (01/2025); BAZG: Wertfreigrenze 150 Franken

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Fuel
rows.value: Fuel in the vehicle tank is free; up to 25 litres in a spare can duty-free, then CHF 0.80 duty per litre
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: BAZG: Treibstoff und Fahrzeugreparaturen

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Cash: no declaration required; travellers must answer questions on amounts of
rows.note: or more (origin, use and beneficial owner)

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Tariff lookup
rows.value: Swiss customs tariff Tares (www.tares.ch)
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: BAZG: Zolltarif Tares (linked from BAZG: Zölle and Empfangen von Briefen und Paketen)

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Travellers: air, sea and land arrivals
rows.value: One set of allowances per person and day, the same for every mode of arrival; parcels and online orders follow the consignment rules instead
rows.note: Swiss customs rules, applied in Liechtenstein under the 1923 customs treaty.
rows.source_title: BAZG: Info Zoll für Privatpersonen (01/2025); BAZG: Wertfreigrenze 150 Franken

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: income tax
rows.value: Business profit (from accounts or proper records) is added to other income and taxed at the national tariff plus the municipal surcharge; equity capital earns a deductible notional interest at the 4% Sollertrag rate
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 18 and 19 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: AHV contribution
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: IV contribution
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: FAK contribution
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: administration costs (VK)
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: total AHV/IV/FAK/VK
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: fixed minimum contribution per year when income is below CHF 3,000
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: unemployment insurance
rows.value: None: the self-employed pay no ALV contributions
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: occupational pension (second pillar)
rows.value: Voluntary: they may join their employees' fund or a collective foundation, paying the full contribution
rows.source_title: BPVG Art. 5 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Flat-rate or simplified income-tax regime
rows.value: No flat income-tax regime; VAT net tax rate method up to CHF 5,024,000 turnover and CHF 108,000 tax
rows.source_title: Mehrwertsteuergesetz (MWSTG) Art. 37 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: VAT registration threshold (turnover per year)
rows.source_title: Mehrwertsteuergesetz (MWSTG) Art. 10 and 25 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Residence permit for self-employment: EEA and Swiss nationals
rows.value: Short-stay permit (up to 1 year) or residence permit if the professional and trade requirements for self-employment are met and commuting is not reasonable; permit numbers are capped and many are allocated by lottery
rows.source_title: PFZG Art. 10, 15, 16; PFZV Art. 23 to 27; Ausländergesetz (AuG) Art. 13 to 30

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Residence permit for self-employment: other nationals
rows.value: No permit for setting up as self-employed: work permits require a Liechtenstein employer's application (managers, specialists and qualified staff only); people already holding a residence or settlement permit may become self-employed
rows.source_title: PFZG Art. 10, 15, 16; PFZV Art. 23 to 27; Ausländergesetz (AuG) Art. 13 to 30

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Where to apply
rows.value: Ausländer- und Passamt (Immigration and Passport Office), Vaduz
rows.source_title: PFZG Art. 10, 15, 16; PFZV Art. 23 to 27; Ausländergesetz (AuG) Art. 13 to 30

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad or freelance visa
rows.value: None: there is no permit for remote work for a foreign employer or client
rows.source_title: Ausländergesetz (AuG) Art. 13 and 20 (version of 12.06.2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Tax residence test (SteG Art. 2 and 6)
rows.value: Domicile in Liechtenstein, or habitual abode: any continuous stay of more than 6 months (from the first day); stays for education, care or holidays up to 12 months do not count
rows.source_title: Finanzgesetz 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Art. 2 and 3; SteG Art. 2, 6, 23; tax treaties with CH and AT, Art. 15

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Taxation of new residents and permit holders
rows.value: Residents are taxed on worldwide income and wealth; income and wealth from foreign real estate and foreign permanent establishments are exempt (progression reserved); there is no exemption period for other foreign income
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 6 and 15 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Social security of residents and people working in Liechtenstein
rows.value: Compulsory AHV/IV/FAK for everyone resident or working in Liechtenstein (AHVG Art. 34)
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Social-security agreements (note)
rows.value: For EEA or EFTA nationals in a case limited to the EEA or EFTA area, Regulations (EC) 883/2004 and 987/2009 decide which state insures a person; there is no single agreement covering Liechtenstein, Switzerland and Austria together, so a case involving all three is split by state of work
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Unterstellung

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound regime: lump-sum taxation (Besteuerung nach dem Aufwand)
rows.value: On application, for foreign nationals taking up residence for the first time or after 10 years abroad who do not work in Liechtenstein: 25% of annual living expenditure instead of income and wealth tax; Liechtenstein real estate stays subject to wealth tax; no time limit and no application deadline
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 30 to 34 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound regime for employees or experts
rows.value: None: incoming employees are taxed under the ordinary rules (the lump-sum regime excludes gainful activity in Liechtenstein)
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 30 to 34 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Non-residents: tax on employment income
rows.value: Final source deduction set by the Steuerverwaltung; ordinary assessment at the national tariff from CHF 211,400 gross pay (or on request), with a 150% surcharge in 2026
rows.source_title: Finanzgesetz 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Art. 2 and 3; SteG Art. 2, 6, 23; tax treaties with CH and AT, Art. 15

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Cross-border commuters from Austria: Liechtenstein source tax
rows.note: the commuter is taxed in Austria, the state of residence
rows.source_title: Finanzgesetz 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Art. 2 and 3; SteG Art. 2, 6, 23; tax treaties with CH and AT, Art. 15

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Cross-border commuters from Switzerland
rows.value: Taxed only in Switzerland; commuter status lapses after more than 45 working days a year without returning home for work reasons
rows.source_title: Finanzgesetz 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Art. 2 and 3; SteG Art. 2, 6, 23; tax treaties with CH and AT, Art. 15

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Income and wealth tax (national tax) (Vermögens- und Erwerbssteuer (Landessteuer))
rows.value: 0% to 8%; tax-free up to CHF 15,855 (single parents CHF 23,783, couples CHF 31,710)
rows.note: National; paid by: Residents (worldwide income plus a 4% notional yield on net wealth); non-residents on Liechtenstein income; legal basis: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 6 to 22, LR 640.0
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Municipal surcharge on income and wealth tax (Gemeindezuschlag)
rows.value: 150% to 250% of the national tax (150% or 160% for tax year 2025)
rows.note: Municipal; paid by: Residents and non-residents with Liechtenstein real estate or a permanent establishment (not on the source deduction); legal basis: SteG Art. 75 to 77
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 75 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Other surcharges on income tax (solidarity, health or defence levies) (—)
rows.value: None: the only surcharge on the national tax is the municipal surcharge (and the 150% surcharge for non-residents assessed ordinarily)
rows.note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 1, 23 Abs. 5 and 75
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 1 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Church tax (Kirchensteuer)
rows.value: None: the State pays the Roman Catholic Church an annual contribution of CHF 300,000
rows.note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: LR 181.0 Art. 1 and 2; SteG Art. 1
rows.source_title: Gesetz über die Ausrichtung von Beiträgen an die römisch-katholische Landeskirche

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Capital gains of individuals (shares, movable and immovable private assets) (Kapitalgewinne)
rows.value: Exempt from income tax; gains on Liechtenstein land are taxed by the real-estate gains tax
rows.note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 15 Abs. 2 Bst. m and o
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 15 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Real-estate gains tax (Grundstücksgewinnsteuer)
rows.value: Income-tax tariff (Art. 19 Bst. a) on the gain, plus a 200% surcharge instead of the municipal surcharge
rows.note: National; paid by: Seller of Liechtenstein land; legal basis: SteG Art. 35 to 43
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 35 to 43 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (Couponsteuer (aufgehoben))
rows.value: None: coupon tax abolished from 2011 (only pre-2011 reserves); dividends exempt from income tax
rows.note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 15 Abs. 2 Bst. n, 24, 157 Ziff. 5 and 158
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 24, 157 and 158 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Rental income and pension income (Vermögensertrag, Renten)
rows.value: Rent: not taxed (the 4% notional yield on the property is); AHV/IV pensions 30% taxable; occupational pensions in full
rows.note: National; paid by: Residents; legal basis: SteG Art. 14 Abs. 2 Bst. e, 15 Abs. 1 Bst. a and 16 Abs. 2 Bst. d
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 14 to 16 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (Quellensteuer / Steuerabzug)
rows.value: Final withholding; ordinary assessment from CHF 211,400 (150% surcharge in 2026); Austrian commuters 4%; Swiss commuters exempt
rows.note: National; paid by: Non-resident employees (withheld by the employer); legal basis: SteG Art. 23 to 25; Finanzgesetz 2026 Art. 2 and 3; DBA CH and DBA AT Art. 15 Abs. 4
rows.source_title: Finanzgesetz vom 7. November 2025 für das Jahr 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Social insurance contributions (old age and survivors, invalidity, family compensation, unemployment) (AHV / IV / FAK / ALV)
rows.value: Employee 4.9% AHV/IV/FAK + 0.5% ALV; employer 7.385% AHV/IV/FAK/VK + 0.5% ALV (ALV up to CHF 126,000)
rows.note: National; paid by: Employees and employers; the self-employed (no ALV); legal basis: AHVG, IVG, FZEG, ALVG
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beitragsansätze AHV / IV / FAK / VK (gültig ab 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Employer-only levies: family compensation fund, administration costs, health-insurance contribution, occupational accident premiums (FAK, Verwaltungskosten, Arbeitgeberbeitrag OKP, BU-Prämie)
rows.value: FAK 1.9%; VK 0.585%; health contribution CHF 180.50 a month per adult employee (2026); accident premiums
rows.note: National; paid by: Employers; legal basis: FZEG Art. 45; KVG Art. 24 Abs. 8; UVersG Art. 79
rows.source_title: Regierung: Merkblatt Lohnabrechnung (Stand Januar 2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Self-employed contributions (AHV/IV/FAK Selbständigerwerbende)
rows.value: 12.285% (AHV 8.25%, IV 1.35%, FAK 2.1%, VK 0.585%); CHF 368.55 minimum below CHF 3,000 income; no ALV
rows.note: National; paid by: Self-employed; legal basis: AHVG Art. 41 and 43
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Mandatory occupational pension (second pillar) (Betriebliche Personalvorsorge (BPVG))
rows.value: At least 8% of the insured wage for old age, from an annual wage of CHF 14,700
rows.note: National; paid by: Employers (at least half) and employees; legal basis: BPVG Art. 4 and 7
rows.source_title: Gesetz über die betriebliche Personalvorsorge (BPVG) (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Corporate income tax (Ertragssteuer)
rows.value: 12.5%; minimum tax CHF 1,800 (credited); top-up tax for large groups under the minimum-taxation law
rows.note: National; paid by: Legal persons; legal basis: SteG Art. 1 Abs. 2, 61 and 62
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 61 and 62 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Municipal business or profit tax (—)
rows.value: None: the municipal surcharge applies only to the income and wealth tax; municipalities receive a share of the national corporate tax
rows.note: Municipal; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 75 Abs. 1; Finanzgesetz 2026 budget line 920.352.02
rows.source_title: Finanzgesetz vom 7. November 2025 für das Jahr 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Landesvoranschlag; SteG Art. 75

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Simplified or flat-rate regime for small businesses (Saldosteuersatzmethode (MWST))
rows.value: No flat income-tax regime; VAT net tax rate method up to CHF 5,024,000 turnover and CHF 108,000 tax
rows.note: National; paid by: Small VAT-registered businesses (optional); legal basis: SteG Art. 14 Abs. 2 Bst. b and c, 16 Abs. 1 Bst. b; MWSTG Art. 37
rows.source_title: Mehrwertsteuergesetz (MWSTG) Art. 37 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Formation duty and insurance premium levy (Liechtenstein, where Swiss stamp law does not apply) (Gründungsabgabe, Abgabe auf Versicherungsprämien)
rows.value: 1% of capital above a CHF 1 million exemption (0.5% above CHF 5 million, 0.3% above CHF 10 million); foundations 0.2%, minimum CHF 200
rows.note: National; paid by: Companies, foundations; insurers; legal basis: SteG Art. 66 to 69
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 66 and 67 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Swiss federal stamp duties (issue duty, securities transfer duty, insurance premium duty) (Eidgenössische Stempelabgaben)
rows.value: Issue duty 1%; transfer duty 0.15% or 0.3%; insurance premiums 5% (2.5% single-premium life)
rows.note: Swiss federal (customs treaty); paid by: Companies issuing shares; securities dealers; insurers (passed on to policyholders); legal basis: Swiss Stempelabgabengesetz (SR 641.10), applicable in Liechtenstein (LGBl. 2026 Nr. 315)
rows.source_title: ESTV: Die eidgenössischen Stempelabgaben (Stand 1. Januar 2024); Kundmachung LGBl. 2026 Nr. 315

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Value added tax (Mehrwertsteuer (MWST))
rows.value: 8.1% standard; 2.6% reduced; 3.8% accommodation
rows.note: National; paid by: Businesses with turnover of CHF 100,000 or more; consumers bear it; legal basis: MWSTG Art. 10 and 25; VAT treaty with Switzerland
rows.source_title: Mehrwertsteuergesetz (MWSTG) (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Regional or municipal sales tax (—)
rows.value: None: VAT is the only general consumption tax; municipalities levy only the surcharge on income and wealth tax and fees
rows.note: Municipal; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 1 and 75; MWSTG
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 1 and 75 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Excise duties (tobacco, beer, spirits, mineral oil) and automobile tax on imported cars (Tabaksteuer, Biersteuer, Spirituosensteuer, Mineralölsteuer, Automobilsteuer)
rows.value: Swiss federal rates; automobile tax 4% of the vehicle value
rows.note: Swiss federal (customs treaty); paid by: Importers and manufacturers (passed on in prices); legal basis: SR 641.31, 641.411, 641.51, 641.61, 680 (applicable under the customs treaty, LGBl. 2026 Nr. 312)
rows.source_title: BAZG: Automobilsteuer; BAZG: Interneteinkauf: Steuern und Abgaben; Kundmachung LGBl. 2026 Nr. 312

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: CO2 levy on heating and process fuels (CO2-Abgabe)
rows.value: CHF 120 per tonne of CO2
rows.note: National; paid by: Producers and importers of fossil heating fuels; legal basis: CO2-Gesetz (LR 814.065) Art. 3; CO2-Verordnung Art. 5
rows.source_title: CO2-Verordnung; CO2-Gesetz Art. 3

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Property tax (land and buildings) (—)
rows.value: No separate property tax: real estate is part of taxable wealth (valued at income value, at least the tax valuation) and taxed through the 4% notional yield
rows.note: National; paid by: Owners (through the wealth tax); legal basis: SteG Art. 9 and 12 Abs. 2
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 1, 9 and 12 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Property transfer charges (Grundbuchgebühr (Eigentumsübertragung))
rows.value: No transfer tax; land-register fee 6‰ of the price (minimum CHF 200); mortgage registration 2‰
rows.note: National; paid by: Buyer (land register entry); legal basis: Grundbuch- und Handelsregistergebührenverordnung (GbHr-GebV), LR 214.011
rows.source_title: Grundbuch- und Handelsregistergebührenverordnung (version of 01.08.2024)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Wealth tax (Vermögenssteuer (Sollertrag))
rows.value: 4% of net wealth is added to taxable income (notional yield) and taxed at the income-tax rate, plus the municipal surcharge
rows.note: National; paid by: Residents; legal basis: SteG Art. 5, 9 to 12 and 14 Abs. 2 Bst. l
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 5 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Tax on transfers to non-exempt foundations and similar structures (Widmungssteuer)
rows.value: 3.5% of the wealth-tax value of the transfer
rows.note: National; paid by: The person transferring assets; legal basis: SteG Art. 13
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 13 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Inheritance, estate and gift tax (Erbschafts- und Schenkungssteuer)
rows.value: None since 2011: inheritances and gifts are not taxed (they add to the recipient's taxable wealth)
rows.note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 1, 15 Abs. 2 Bst. c and 157
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 1, 15 and 157 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Annual motor vehicle tax (Motorfahrzeugsteuer)
rows.value: Cars from CHF 114.10 a year (by weight); motorcycles CHF 45.65 + CHF 11.40 per 100 ccm
rows.note: National; paid by: Vehicle keepers; legal basis: Motorfahrzeugsteuergesetz, LR 641.51, Art. 11 and 12
rows.source_title: Gesetz über die Motorfahrzeugsteuer (version of 01.10.2019)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Performance-related heavy vehicle fee (Leistungsabhängige Schwerverkehrsabgabe (LSVA))
rows.value: Per tonne-kilometre; the tariff must lie between 0.6 and 2.5 Rappen (up to 3 Rappen for 40-tonne vehicles)
rows.note: National; paid by: Keepers of heavy goods vehicles; legal basis: Schwerverkehrsabgabegesetz (SVAG), LR 641.81; treaty with Switzerland LR 0.641.891.011
rows.source_title: Gesetz über eine leistungsabhängige Schwerverkehrsabgabe (SVAG) (version of 01.01.2025)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Tourist tax (overnight stays) (Kurtaxe)
rows.value: CHF 3.50 per night in hotels; CHF 2.50 holiday homes; CHF 1.50 campsites
rows.note: National; paid by: Guests (collected by the accommodation provider); legal basis: Verordnung über die Melde- und Taxpflicht bei Beherbergungen (BMTV), LR 935.201.1
rows.source_title: Beherbergungsverordnung (BMTV) (version of 01.01.2024)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Dog tax (Hundesteuer)
rows.value: CHF 20 to 100 per dog, set by each municipality; double for the second and each further dog (Schaan 2026: CHF 100 and CHF 200)
rows.note: Municipal; paid by: Dog owners; legal basis: Hundegesetz Art. 10c (as quoted by the Schaan council)
rows.source_title: Gemeinde Schaan: Gemeinderatsprotokoll vom 26. November 2025 (Hundesteuer 2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Customs duties and import VAT (Zoll, Einfuhrsteuer (Schweizer Zollgebiet))
rows.value: Swiss tariff (mostly per kg); duty or VAT under CHF 5 not collected; travellers CHF 150 VAT-free
rows.note: Swiss federal (customs treaty); paid by: Importers and travellers; legal basis: Zollvertrag 1923 Art. 1; Swiss Customs Act and Customs Tariff Act (LGBl. 2026 Nr. 312)
rows.source_title: BAZG: Empfangen von Briefen und Paketen

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Lump-sum taxation for new residents without gainful activity (Besteuerung nach dem Aufwand)
rows.value: 25% of annual living expenditure, instead of income and wealth tax
rows.note: National; paid by: Foreign nationals moving to Liechtenstein who do not work there (on application); legal basis: SteG Art. 30 to 34
rows.source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 30 to 34 (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Personal income tax scale 2026 (gyventojų pajamų mokestis, GPM)
rows.basis: Annual income from employment and other income taxed on the general scale (after the NPD and allowable deductions), residents
rows.note: Thresholds are 36 and 60 times the 2026 average wage (VDU) of €2,312.15 used for the social insurance base. The middle 25% band is new for 2026.
rows.source_title: e-seimas: Lietuvos Respublikos gyventojų pajamų mokesčio įstatymas Nr. IX-1007, suvestinė redakcija nuo 2026-06-11 iki 2026-12-31, 6 straipsnio 1 dalis; Seimas: Valstybės socialinių fondų biudžetų 2026 metų rodiklių patvirtinimo įstatymas Nr. XV-632, 4 straipsnis

rows.section: Thresholds and other income 2026

rows.basis: Annual income of each type
rows.note: Income taxed at the 15% non-employment rate and individual-activity income are counted first when the annual 20/25/32% bands are applied (GPM art. 6(11)).

rows.section: Thresholds and other income 2026

rows.section: Thresholds and other income 2026

rows.basis: Annual income of each type

rows.section: Tax-exempt amount (NPD) 2026
rows.label: Maximum monthly NPD (monthly employment income up to the minimum monthly wage)
rows.basis: Deducted from employment income only; applied monthly at one employer on request, or in the annual return
rows.note: Non-residents get the NPD only in the annual return. The NPD does not apply to individual-activity or other non-employment income.
rows.source_title: e-seimas: Lietuvos Respublikos gyventojų pajamų mokesčio įstatymas Nr. IX-1007, suvestinė redakcija nuo 2026-06-11 iki 2026-12-31, 20 straipsnis (and the version from 2027-01-01, 20 straipsnio 11 dalis)

rows.section: Tax-exempt amount (NPD) 2026
rows.label: Maximum annual NPD
rows.basis: Deducted from employment income only; applied monthly at one employer on request, or in the annual return
rows.note: Non-residents get the NPD only in the annual return. The NPD does not apply to individual-activity or other non-employment income.
rows.source_title: e-seimas: Lietuvos Respublikos gyventojų pajamų mokesčio įstatymas Nr. IX-1007, suvestinė redakcija nuo 2026-06-11 iki 2026-12-31, 20 straipsnis (and the version from 2027-01-01, 20 straipsnio 11 dalis)

rows.section: Tax-exempt amount (NPD) 2026
rows.label: Monthly formula
rows.value: NPD = €747 − 0.49 × (monthly employment income − the minimum monthly wage in force on 1 January, €1,153 in 2026); not below zero
rows.basis: Deducted from employment income only; applied monthly at one employer on request, or in the annual return
rows.note: Non-residents get the NPD only in the annual return. The NPD does not apply to individual-activity or other non-employment income.
rows.source_title: e-seimas: Lietuvos Respublikos gyventojų pajamų mokesčio įstatymas Nr. IX-1007, suvestinė redakcija nuo 2026-06-11 iki 2026-12-31, 20 straipsnis (and the version from 2027-01-01, 20 straipsnio 11 dalis)

rows.section: Tax-exempt amount (NPD) 2026
rows.label: Annual formula
rows.value: NPD = €8,964 − 0.49 × (annual income − 12 × the minimum monthly wage); not below zero
rows.basis: Deducted from employment income only; applied monthly at one employer on request, or in the annual return
rows.note: Non-residents get the NPD only in the annual return. The NPD does not apply to individual-activity or other non-employment income.
rows.source_title: e-seimas: Lietuvos Respublikos gyventojų pajamų mokesčio įstatymas Nr. IX-1007, suvestinė redakcija nuo 2026-06-11 iki 2026-12-31, 20 straipsnis (and the version from 2027-01-01, 20 straipsnio 11 dalis)

rows.section: Tax-exempt amount (NPD) 2026
rows.label: Taper rate
rows.basis: Deducted from employment income only; applied monthly at one employer on request, or in the annual return
rows.note: Non-residents get the NPD only in the annual return. The NPD does not apply to individual-activity or other non-employment income.
rows.source_title: e-seimas: Lietuvos Respublikos gyventojų pajamų mokesčio įstatymas Nr. IX-1007, suvestinė redakcija nuo 2026-06-11 iki 2026-12-31, 20 straipsnis (and the version from 2027-01-01, 20 straipsnio 11 dalis)

rows.section: Tax-exempt amount (NPD) 2026
rows.label: Monthly employment income at which the NPD reaches zero (computed)
rows.basis: Deducted from employment income only; applied monthly at one employer on request, or in the annual return
rows.note: Non-residents get the NPD only in the annual return. The NPD does not apply to individual-activity or other non-employment income.

rows.section: Tax-exempt amount (NPD) 2026
rows.label: Monthly NPD, 0–25% participation level or severe disability
rows.basis: Deducted from employment income only; applied monthly at one employer on request, or in the annual return
rows.note: Non-residents get the NPD only in the annual return. The NPD does not apply to individual-activity or other non-employment income.
rows.source_title: e-seimas: Lietuvos Respublikos gyventojų pajamų mokesčio įstatymas Nr. IX-1007, suvestinė redakcija nuo 2026-06-11 iki 2026-12-31, 20 straipsnis (and the version from 2027-01-01, 20 straipsnio 11 dalis)

rows.section: Tax-exempt amount (NPD) 2026
rows.label: Monthly NPD, 30–55% participation level or moderate or mild disability
rows.basis: Deducted from employment income only; applied monthly at one employer on request, or in the annual return
rows.note: Non-residents get the NPD only in the annual return. The NPD does not apply to individual-activity or other non-employment income.
rows.source_title: e-seimas: Lietuvos Respublikos gyventojų pajamų mokesčio įstatymas Nr. IX-1007, suvestinė redakcija nuo 2026-06-11 iki 2026-12-31, 20 straipsnis (and the version from 2027-01-01, 20 straipsnio 11 dalis)

rows.section: Tax-exempt amount (NPD) 2026
rows.label: Child or dependant allowance
rows.value: None in 2026; from 2027 an additional NPD of €1,044 a year per child (GPM art. 20(11), version from 2027-01-01)

rows.note: Self-employed ZUS figures are the 2026 amounts published by ZUS (accident rate 1.67%). The PIT-0 reliefs above also cover business income taxed on the scale, the flat tax or the ryczałt.

rows.section: IRS general rates, mainland (art. 68.º CIRS)
rows.basis: Taxable income (rendimento coletável), per year
rows.note: Current rates for 2026 income: Decreto-Lei n.º 212/2026, de 4 de novembro (Diário da República, 1.ª série, n.º 214, pp. 5-6, published 2026-11-04; promulgated 2026-11-02; in force from 2026-11-05, applying to income obtained from 2026-01-01). rows.section: Tax-free part of minimum-wage salaries in 2026 (OUG 89/2025, art. III)
rows.label: Conditions
rows.value: Full-time individual employment contract at the main place of work, with a base salary equal to the minimum wage (RON 4,050 to June, RON 4,325 from July 2026); reduced pro rata for part of a month
rows.note: Applies to salaries for January to December 2026 only. Cutting the contract base salary between the ordinance entering into force (December 2025) and 31 December 2026 removes the relief.
rows.source_title: ANAF: Ordonanța de urgență a Guvernului nr. 89 din 23 decembrie 2025 (Monitorul Oficial nr. 1.203 din 24 decembrie 2025), art. III

rows.section: Tax-free part of minimum-wage salaries in 2026 (OUG 89/2025, art. III)
rows.label: Part-time minimum contribution in 2026
rows.value: The minimum wage used for the minimum CAS and CASS on part-time contracts is reduced by RON 300 (January to June) and RON 200 (July to December)
rows.note: Applies to salaries for January to December 2026 only. Cutting the contract base salary between the ordinance entering into force (December 2025) and 31 December 2026 removes the relief.
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 146 alin. (5^6)-(5^9) and art. 168 alin. (6^1); OUG nr. 89/2025 art. III alin. (5)

rows.section: Employee contributions: pension (CAS) and health (CASS)
rows.label: Minimum contribution
rows.value: CAS and CASS are due at least on the minimum wage for the working days of the month, also for part-time contracts (exceptions: pupils and students up to 26, apprentices under 18, persons with disabilities or others allowed by law to work under 8 hours a day, old-age pensioners, several contracts adding up to the minimum wage); the employer pays the difference
rows.basis: Gross monthly pay
